Presence unknown · no automatic start

Phone presence setup

Reserve this IPv4 for your phone in the router. No router login, app or cloud is used by the ESP.

Each round asks via UDP at 0, 5, 12, 22, 30, 40, 50 and 60 seconds if needed, then waits for a reply before ping/TCP fallbacks. A real reply ends the round immediately. Old cache entries and sending a packet alone never confirm presence.

Checks start 90 minutes before light start: every 15 minutes, every 5 minutes in the last 30 minutes, and every 10 minutes while the alarm runs. Otherwise they are paused.

A real response remains valid for 60 minutes. Failed checks do not shorten this grace period: leaving shortly afterwards may remain undetected for up to an hour.

Test with your phone locked overnight. A sleeping phone may be unreachable even when you are home. Keep its private Wi-Fi address fixed for this network.
